messages.subject: [Seqinr-forum] error connecting to ACNUC with choosebank()
messages.subject_clean: [Seqinr-forum] error connecting to ACNUC with choosebank()
messages.body_plain:
Dear all,

I am wondering if the ACNUC database is down today?
When I try to connect using SeqinR, I get this error:

> library("seqinr")
> choosebank("genbank")
Error in if (res[1] != "0") { : argument is of length zero

I guess it means that the ACNUC database is down? I thought I'd tell you
in case you didn't realise.

Kind Regards,
Avril

Avril Coghlan
Ireland

messages.subject: [Seqinr-forum] online booklet with some Seqinr examples
messages.subject_clean: [Seqinr-forum] online booklet with some Seqinr examples
messages.body_plain:
Dear all,

I'm writing a free online booklet on using R for bioinformatics
(basically consisting of practicals that I wrote to teach my students).
I've just written the first couple of chapters and have included some
examples using SeqinR:
http://a-little-book-of-r-for-bioinformatics.readthedocs.org/
In this, I compare using SeqinR to do some searches of the NCBI
database, compared to going directly to the NCBI website.
I thought I would send it to this list, in case any of you have time to
have a quick look and give feedback (which I would appreciate very
much), in particular if I have misunderstood anything about SeqinR..

Kind Regards,
Avril

Avril Coghlan
University College Cork
Ireland
